#Load data
```{r}
#load flanders

# path to folder
shp_dir <- "C:/Users/u0137615/OneDrive - KU Leuven/Phd GARLOCK/3. Onderzoek/WP3/Output/Garden_metric1/BBK_15/Buffers"

# list shapefiles
shp_files <- list.files(shp_dir, pattern = "\\.shp$", full.names = TRUE)

# function to read shapefile and add city column
read_with_city <- function(file) {
  city <- str_extract(basename(file), "^[A-Za-z]+")  # take leading word (e.g. Aalst)
  st_read(file, quiet = TRUE) %>%
    mutate(city = city)
}

# read all and bind.
all_gardens_15 <- map(shp_files, read_with_city) %>%
  bind_rows()
```

#Correlatie plot
```{r}
gardens_analysis <- all_gardens_15[, c("TWIrisk50","LSTrisk50", "BAF1_50","BAF2_50","BIMDhe50", "BIMDc50","BIMDho50","STATUNEMP5","STATHH150", "STATHH_K50","STATRent50", "STATEDU50","STATEld50","STATEU50","STATN_EU50", "garden_50", "bldg_50","UGEI_50","exp50")]

gardens_analysis <- st_drop_geometry(gardens_analysis)
# Convert all columns to numeric
gardens_analysis[] <- lapply(gardens_analysis, function(x) as.numeric(as.character(x)))

# Calculate Spearman correlation coefficients
cor_matrix <- cor(gardens_analysis, method = "spearman", use="complete.obs")

# Create a correlation heatmap
corrplot(
  cor_matrix,
  method = "color",
  type = "upper",
  tl.cex = 0.8,
  tl.col = "black",
  tl.srt = 45,
  addCoef.col = "black",
  title = "Spearman Correlation Heatmap"
)
```

#Linear model
```{r}
gardens_analysis2 <- all_gardens_15[, c("TWIrisk50","LSTrisk50", "BAF1_50","BAF2_50","BIMDhe50", "BIMDc50","BIMDho50","STATUNEMP5","STATHH150", "STATHH_K50","STATRent50", "STATEDU50","STATEld50","STATEU50","STATN_EU50", "garden_50", "bldg_50","UGEI_50h","exp50")]

gardens_analysis2 <- st_drop_geometry(gardens_analysis2)
# Convert all columns to numeric
gardens_analysis2[] <- lapply(gardens_analysis2, function(x) as.numeric(as.character(x)))

hist(gardens_analysis2$UGEI_50h)

model <- lm(UGEI_50h ~ TWIrisk50 + LSTrisk50 + exp50 + BIMDhe50 + BIMDc50 + BIMDho50 + STATUNEMP5 + STATHH150 + STATHH_K50 + STATRent50 + STATEDU50 + STATEld50 + STATEU50 + STATN_EU50, data= gardens_analysis2)
summary(model)

model <- lm(UGEI_50h ~ garden_50 + bldg_50, data= gardens_analysis2)
summary(model)

# make a copy to keep your original data safe
gardens_scaled <- gardens_analysis2  

# standardize all predictors except the outcome
predictors <- c("TWIrisk50", "LSTrisk50", "BIMDhe50", "BIMDc50", "BIMDho50", 
                "STATUNEMP5", "STATHH150", "STATHH_K50", "STATRent50", 
                "STATEDU50", "STATEld50", "STATEU50", "STATN_EU50","exp50")

gardens_scaled[predictors] <- scale(gardens_scaled[predictors])

# fit model with standardized predictors
model_scaled <- lm(UGEI_50h ~ ., data = gardens_scaled[, c("UGEI_50h", predictors)])
summary(model_scaled)
vif(model_scaled)

# standardize all predictors except the outcome
predictors <- c("TWIrisk50", "LSTrisk50", "BIMDhe50", "BIMDc50", "BIMDho50", 
                "STATUNEMP5", "STATHH150", "STATHH_K50", "STATRent50", 
                "STATEDU50", "STATEld50", "STATEU50","exp50")

gardens_scaled[predictors] <- scale(gardens_scaled[predictors])

# fit model with standardized predictors
model_scaled <- lm(UGEIh_50 ~ ., data = gardens_scaled[, c("UGEI_50", predictors)])
summary(model_scaled)
vif(model_scaled)

library(DHARMa)
# Simulate residuals
sim_res <- simulateResiduals(model_scaled)
# Plot diagnostics
plot(sim_res)

library(glmmTMB)
gardens_scaled$UGEI_rescaled <- (gardens_scaled$UGEIh_50 + 1) / 2
formula_tmb <- as.formula(
  paste("UGEI_rescaled ~", paste(predictors, collapse = " + "))
)

model_tmb <- glmmTMB(
  formula_tmb,
  data   = gardens_scaled,
  family = beta_family(link = "logit")
)

library(DHARMa)
sim_res <- simulateResiduals(model_tmb)
plot(sim_res)

library(dotwhisker)
library(broom)
library(ggplot2)

# Tidy model coefficients
coef_df <- tidy(model_scaled, conf.int = TRUE)
coef_df <- subset(coef_df, term != "(Intercept)")

# Add significance column
coef_df$sig <- ifelse(coef_df$p.value < 0.05, "Significant", "Not Significant")

# Add a dummy 'model' column (required by dwplot)
coef_df$model <- "Standardized LM"

# Optional: order predictors
coef_df$term <- factor(coef_df$term, levels = rev(c(
  "TWIrisk50", "LSTrisk50", "BIMDhe50", "BIMDc50", "BIMDho50",
  "STATUNEMP5", "STATHH150", "STATHH_K50", "STATRent50",
  "STATEDU50", "STATEld50", "STATEU50", "STATN_EU50", "exp50"
)))

# Forest plot using dwplot aesthetics
dwplot(coef_df, dot_args = list(aes(shape = sig, colour = sig), size = 4)) +
  scale_color_manual(values = c("Significant" = "black", "Not Significant" = "grey60")) +
  scale_shape_manual(values = c("Significant" = 16, "Not Significant" = 1)) +  # filled vs hollow
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", color = "red") +
  labs(x = "Standardized Coefficient (β)", y = "",
       title = "Forest Plot of Standardized Model") +
  theme_bw(base_size = 16) +
  theme(legend.position = "none")


library(mgcv)

 "TWIrisk50", "LSTrisk50", "BIMDhe50", "BIMDc50", "BIMDho50",
  "STATUNEMP5", "STATHH150", "STATHH_K50", "STATRent50",
  "STATEDU50", "STATEld50", "STATEU50", "STATN_EU50", "exp50"

# Simple GAM with continuous UGEI index
gam_model <- gam(
  UGEI_50h ~ s(TWIrisk50) + s(LSTrisk50) + s(BIMDhe50) + s(BIMDc50) + s(BIMDho50) 
                  s(STATUNEMP5) + s(STATHH150) ,
  data = gardens_scaled,
  family = gaussian()
)

summary(gam_model)  # check significance of each smooth
plot(gam_model, pages = 1)  # visualize smooth effects
```

#HOTSPOT analyse
```{r}
library(spdep)


gardens_analysis3 <- all_gardens_15[, c("BAFper_50","BAFtot_50","TWIrisk50","LSTrisk50","vul50","exp50","UGEI_50h", "BAF1_50","BAF2_50","haz50","BIMDhe50", "BIMDc50","BIMDho50","STATUNEMP5","STATHH150", "STATHH_K50","STATRent50", "STATEDU50","STATEld50","STATEU50","STATN_EU50", "risk50")]

garden_analysis3_subset <- gardens_analysis3[is.finite(gardens_analysis3$UGEI_50h), ]

# Create a neighbor list
list_nb <- poly2nb(garden_analysis3_subset, queen=TRUE,  snap=10)

# Check for empty neighbor sets
# card() calculates number of neighbors for each polygon in the list
# which() finds polygons with 0 neighbors
empty_nb <- which(card(list_nb) == 0)
empty_nb  

# Remove polygons with empty neighbor sets from the data
garden_analysis3_subset <- garden_analysis3_subset[-empty_nb, ]

# Now that we removed empty neighbor sets (tes_subset)
# Identify neighbors with queen contiguity (edge/vertex touching)
tes_nb <- poly2nb(garden_analysis3_subset, queen=TRUE,  snap=10)

# Binary weighting assigns a weight of 1 to all neighboring features 
# and a weight of 0 to all other features
tes_w_binary <- nb2listw(tes_nb, style="W")

# Calculate spatial lag of TreEqty
tes_lag <- lag.listw(tes_w_binary, garden_analysis3_subset$UGEI_50h)

# Test for global Moran I statistic 
moran.test(garden_analysis3_subset$UGEI_50h, tes_w_binary)

local_moran <- localmoran(garden_analysis3_subset$UGEI_50h, tes_w_binary)

local_moran <- localmoran(garden_analysis3_subset$UGEI_50h, tes_w_binary)

garden_analysis3_subset$Ii <- local_moran[, "Ii"]
garden_analysis3_subset$Z_Ii <- local_moran[, "Z.Ii"]
garden_analysis3_subset$p_value <- local_moran[, "Pr(z != E(Ii))"]

# Spatial lag of UGEI
garden_analysis3_subset$UGEI_lag <- lag.listw(tes_w_binary, garden_analysis3_subset$UGEI_50h)

# Mean of UGEI
UGEI_mean <- mean(garden_analysis3_subset$UGEI_50h, na.rm = TRUE)

# Create cluster category
garden_analysis3_subset$cluster <- NA
garden_analysis3_subset$cluster[
  garden_analysis3_subset$UGEI_50h > UGEI_mean & 
  garden_analysis3_subset$UGEI_lag > UGEI_mean & 
  garden_analysis3_subset$p_value <= 0.05] <- "High-High"

garden_analysis3_subset$cluster[
  garden_analysis3_subset$UGEI_50h < UGEI_mean & 
  garden_analysis3_subset$UGEI_lag < UGEI_mean & 
  garden_analysis3_subset$p_value <= 0.05] <- "Low-Low"

garden_analysis3_subset$cluster[
  garden_analysis3_subset$UGEI_50h > UGEI_mean & 
  garden_analysis3_subset$UGEI_lag < UGEI_mean & 
  garden_analysis3_subset$p_value <= 0.05] <- "High-Low"

garden_analysis3_subset$cluster[
  garden_analysis3_subset$UGEI_50h < UGEI_mean & 
  garden_analysis3_subset$UGEI_lag > UGEI_mean & 
  garden_analysis3_subset$p_value <= 0.05] <- "Low-High"

# Everything else = not significant
garden_analysis3_subset$cluster[is.na(garden_analysis3_subset$cluster)] <- "Not significant"

# ---- New: categorize p-values ----
garden_analysis3_subset$p_category <- cut(
  garden_analysis3_subset$p_value,
  breaks = c(-Inf, 0.001, 0.01, 0.05, Inf),
  labels = c("p <= 0.001", "p <= 0.01", "p <= 0.05", "No significance"),
  right = TRUE
)

# Quick check of counts per cluster and p-value
library(dplyr)

summary_table <- garden_analysis3_subset %>%
  group_by(p_category) %>%
  summarise(Number_of_gardens = n(), .groups = "drop") %>%
  mutate(Percent_of_gardens = Number_of_gardens / sum(Number_of_gardens) * 100)

summary_table

cluster_summary <- garden_analysis3_subset %>%
  group_by(cluster) %>%
  summarise(Number_of_gardens = n(), .groups = "drop") %>%
  mutate(Percent_of_gardens = Number_of_gardens / sum(Number_of_gardens) * 100)

cluster_summary
```

#BILISA
```{r}
library(bispdep)
library(dplyr)

gardens_analysis3 <- all_gardens_15[, c("BAFper_50","BAFtot_50","TWIrisk50","LSTrisk50","vul50","exp50","UGEI_50h", "BAF1_50","BAF2_50","haz50","BIMDhe50", "BIMDc50","BIMDho50","STATUNEMP5","STATHH150", "STATHH_K50","STATRent50", "STATEDU50","STATEld50","STATEU50","STATN_EU50", "risk50")]

garden_analysis3_subset <- gardens_analysis3[is.finite(gardens_analysis3$UGEI_50h), ]

# Assume garden_analysis3_subset already cleaned and neighbors defined as tes_w_binary

# Create a neighbor list
list_nb <- poly2nb(garden_analysis3_subset, queen=TRUE,  snap=10)

# Check for empty neighbor sets
# card() calculates number of neighbors for each polygon in the list
# which() finds polygons with 0 neighbors
empty_nb <- which(card(list_nb) == 0)
empty_nb  

# Remove polygons with empty neighbor sets from the data
garden_analysis3_subset <- garden_analysis3_subset[-empty_nb, ]

# Now that we removed empty neighbor sets (tes_subset)
# Identify neighbors with queen contiguity (edge/vertex touching)
tes_nb <- poly2nb(garden_analysis3_subset, queen=TRUE,  snap=10)

# Binary weighting assigns a weight of 1 to all neighboring features 
# and a weight of 0 to all other features
tes_w_binary <- nb2listw(tes_nb, style="W")

# Variables
varX <- garden_analysis3_subset$haz50   # dependent
varY <- garden_analysis3_subset$BAFtot_50  # explanatory

# Run bivariate Local Moran's I
local_bi <- bispdep::localmoran.bi(varX, varY, tes_w_binary, alternative="two.sided")

# Inspect results
head(local_bi)

# Add key columns to your data
garden_analysis3_subset$Ii_bi <- local_bi[, "Ixyi"]
garden_analysis3_subset$Z_Ii_bi <- local_bi[, "Z.Ixyi"]
garden_analysis3_subset$p_value_bi <- local_bi[, "Pr(z != 0)"]

# Spatial lag of varY for cluster assignment
varY_lag <- lag.listw(tes_w_binary, varY)

# Mean values
varX_mean <- mean(varX, na.rm=TRUE)
varY_lag_mean <- mean(varY_lag, na.rm=TRUE)

# Classify bivariate clusters
garden_analysis3_subset$cluster_bi <- NA
garden_analysis3_subset$cluster_bi[
  varX > varX_mean & varY_lag > varY_lag_mean & garden_analysis3_subset$p_value_bi <= 0.05] <- "High-High"
garden_analysis3_subset$cluster_bi[
  varX < varX_mean & varY_lag < varY_lag_mean & garden_analysis3_subset$p_value_bi <= 0.05] <- "Low-Low"
garden_analysis3_subset$cluster_bi[
  varX > varX_mean & varY_lag < varY_lag_mean & garden_analysis3_subset$p_value_bi <= 0.05] <- "High-Low"
garden_analysis3_subset$cluster_bi[
  varX < varX_mean & varY_lag > varY_lag_mean & garden_analysis3_subset$p_value_bi <= 0.05] <- "Low-High"
garden_analysis3_subset$cluster_bi[is.na(garden_analysis3_subset$cluster_bi)] <- "Not significant"

# Quick summary
# Categorize p-values
garden_analysis3_subset$p_category_bi <- cut(
  garden_analysis3_subset$p_value_bi,
  breaks = c(-Inf, 0.001, 0.01, 0.05, Inf),
  labels = c("p <= 0.001", "p <= 0.01", "p <= 0.05", "Not significant"),
  right = TRUE
)

# Summarize number and percentage of gardens per cluster
cluster_summary <- garden_analysis3_subset %>%
  group_by(cluster_bi) %>%
  summarise(
    Number_of_gardens = n(),
    Percent_of_gardens = n() / nrow(garden_analysis3_subset) * 100,
    .groups = "drop"
  )

# Summarize number and percentage of gardens per p-value category
pval_summary <- garden_analysis3_subset %>%
  group_by(p_category_bi) %>%
  summarise(
    Number_of_gardens = n(),
    Percent_of_gardens = n() / nrow(garden_analysis3_subset) * 100,
    .groups = "drop"
  )

# Print summaries
cluster_summary
pval_summary

global_moran <- moran_bv(varX, varY, tes_w_binary, nsim = 499, scale = TRUE)
global_moran

```

#PCA analyse
```{r}
#run UGEI cluster analysis before!!!!
pca_vars <- garden_analysis3_subset[, c("BAFper_50","BAFtot_50","TWIrisk50","LSTrisk50","exp50", "BAF1_50","BAF2_50","BIMDhe50", "BIMDc50","BIMDho50","STATUNEMP5","STATHH150", "STATHH_K50","STATRent50", "STATEDU50","STATEld50","STATEU50","STATN_EU50")]

pca_vars <- st_drop_geometry(pca_vars)
pca_vars <- na.omit(pca_vars)
# Scale the variables
pca_scaled <- scale(pca_vars)

pca_res <- prcomp(pca_scaled, center = TRUE, scale. = TRUE)
summary(pca_res)   # variance explained

library(factoextra)

# Add cluster categories to metadata
clusters <- garden_analysis3_subset$cluster

# Create a named vector of nicer labels
var_labels <- c(
  BAFper_50   = "Effic",
  BAFtot_50   = "Gap",
  TWIrisk50   = "Flood",
  LSTrisk50   = "Heat",
  exp50       = "Pop Dens",
  BAF1_50     = "Contr",
  BAF2_50     = "Pot",
  BIMDhe50     = "Health",
  BIMDc50      = "Crime",
  BIMDho50     = "Housing",
  STATUNEMP5  = "Unemp",
  STATHH150    = "Single",
  STATHH_K50   = "Children",
  STATRent50   = "Rent",
  STATEDU50    = "Edu",
  STATEld50    = "Eld",
  STATEU50     = "Eur",
  STATN_EU50   = "Non-Eur"
)

# Update rownames of the rotation matrix (variables)
rownames(pca_res$rotation) <- var_labels[rownames(pca_res$rotation)]


library(factoextra)

FL <- fviz_pca_biplot(
  pca_res, 
  geom.ind = "point", 
  col.ind = clusters,  # color by cluster
  palette = c(
    "High-High"="#407ca2",
    "Low-Low"="#c85a5a",
    "High-Low"="#c6d9e4",
    "Low-High"="#f7d9d9",
    "Not significant"="grey70"
  ),
  col.var = "black",   # variable arrows/labels
  addEllipses = TRUE, 
  legend.title = "LISA cluster",
  repel = TRUE,
  # Increase font sizes
  labelsize = 6,          # variable labels
  pointsize = 3           # observation points
) +
  ggtitle("A. PCA Biplot – Flemish cities") +
  theme(
    text = element_text(size = 26),       # base text size for all
    plot.title = element_text(size = 28, face = "bold", hjust = 0.5),
    legend.title = element_text(size = 22),
    legend.text = element_text(size = 20)
  )


# Contribution of variables to PC1
PC1_F <- fviz_contrib(pca_res, choice = "var", axes = 1, 
             top = 20, # optionally limit number of variables shown
             ggtheme = theme_minimal()) +
  scale_x_discrete(labels = var_labels)

# Contribution of variables to PC2
PC2_F <- fviz_contrib(pca_res, choice = "var", axes = 2, 
             top = 20,
             ggtheme = theme_minimal()) +
  scale_x_discrete(labels = var_labels)

FL

ggsave("C:/Users/u0137615/OneDrive - KU Leuven/Phd GARLOCK/3. Onderzoek/WP3/Paper/Figures/Flanders_PCA.png", FL, width = 15, height = 15, dpi = 300)
```

#Random forest
```{r}

run_hotspot_nis <- function(x) {

  x <- x[is.finite(x$UGEI_50h), ]
  if (nrow(x) < 5) return(NULL)

  nb <- poly2nb(x, queen = TRUE, snap = 10)
  iso <- which(card(nb) == 0)
  if (length(iso) > 0) {
    x <- x[-iso, ]
    nb <- poly2nb(x, queen = TRUE, snap = 10)
  }

  lw <- nb2listw(nb, style = "W")
  lm <- localmoran(x$UGEI_50h, lw)

  x$p_value <- lm[, "Pr(z != E(Ii))"]
  x$UGEI_lag <- lag.listw(lw, x$UGEI_50h)
  mu <- mean(x$UGEI_50h, na.rm = TRUE)

  x$cluster <- "Not significant"
  sig <- x$p_value <= 0.05
  x$cluster[sig & x$UGEI_50h > mu & x$UGEI_lag > mu] <- "High-High"
  x$cluster[sig & x$UGEI_50h < mu & x$UGEI_lag < mu] <- "Low-Low"
  x$cluster[sig & x$UGEI_50h > mu & x$UGEI_lag < mu] <- "High-Low"
  x$cluster[sig & x$UGEI_50h < mu & x$UGEI_lag > mu] <- "Low-High"

  x
}

hotspot_results <- map(gardens_by_nis, run_hotspot_nis)
hotspot_results <- hotspot_results[!map_lgl(hotspot_results, is.null)]

run_pca_nis <- function(x, nis) {

  # Select only PCA vars + cluster
  x_pca <- x %>%
    select(all_of(names(var_labels)), cluster) %>%
    st_drop_geometry() %>%
    na.omit()

  if (nrow(x_pca) < 10) return(NULL)

  # Separate variables and clusters
  vars     <- x_pca[, names(var_labels)]
  clusters <- x_pca$cluster

  # PCA
  pca <- prcomp(vars, scale. = TRUE)

  # Rename variable loadings
  rownames(pca$rotation) <- var_labels[rownames(pca$rotation)]

  # Translate NISCODE → city name
  city_name <- niscode_names[as.character(nis)]
  if (is.na(city_name)) city_name <- paste("NIS", nis)

  # Plot
  p <- fviz_pca_biplot(
    pca,
    geom.ind = "point",
    col.ind = clusters,
    col.var = "black",        # ✅ variable arrows & labels
    palette = c(
      "High-High" = "#407ca2",
      "Low-Low"  = "#c85a5a",
      "High-Low" = "#c6d9e4",
      "Low-High" = "#f7d9d9",
      "Not significant" = "grey70"
    ),
    addEllipses = TRUE,
    legend.title = "LISA cluster",
    repel = TRUE
  ) +
    ggtitle(paste("PCA –", city_name))

  ggsave(
    paste0(
      "C:/Users/u0137615/OneDrive - KU Leuven/Phd GARLOCK/3. Onderzoek/WP3/Paper/Figures/results/pca/PCA_",
      city_name, ".png"
    ),
    p,
    width = 10, height = 10, dpi = 300
  )
  
  return(p)

  pca
}

pca_results <- imap(hotspot_results, run_pca_nis)

run_pca_nis <- function(x, nis) {

  x_pca <- x %>%
    select(all_of(names(var_labels))) %>%
    st_drop_geometry() %>%
    na.omit()

  if (nrow(x_pca) < 10) return(NULL)

  pca <- prcomp(x_pca, scale. = TRUE)

  loadings <- as.data.frame(pca$rotation[, 1:2]) %>%
    tibble::rownames_to_column("variable") %>%
    mutate(
      variable = var_labels[variable],
      city = niscode_names[as.character(nis)]
    )

  loadings
}

run_rf_nis <- function(x, nis) {

  x <- x %>% filter(cluster %in% c("High-High", "Low-Low"))
  if (nrow(x) < 20) return(NULL)

  rf <- randomForest(
    as.factor(cluster) ~ BAF1_50 + BAFper_50 + BAF2_50 + BAFtot_50 +
      TWIrisk50 + LSTrisk50 + exp50 + BIMDhe50 + BIMDc50 + BIMDho50 +
      STATUNEMP5 + STATHH150 + STATHH_K50 + STATRent50 +
      STATEDU50 + STATEld50 + STATEU50 + STATN_EU50,
    data = x,
    importance = TRUE,
    ntree = 500
  )

  # ---- importance table ----
  imp_df <- importance(rf) %>%
    as.data.frame() %>%
    tibble::rownames_to_column("variable") %>%
    dplyr::select(variable, MeanDecreaseAccuracy) %>%
    dplyr::mutate(
      variable = rf_labels[variable]
    ) %>%
    dplyr::arrange(MeanDecreaseAccuracy)
  
  # Translate NISCODE → city name
  city_name <- niscode_names[as.character(nis)]
  if (is.na(city_name)) city_name <- paste("NIS", nis)

  # ---- lollipop plot ----
  p <- ggplot(
    imp_df,
    aes(
      x = MeanDecreaseAccuracy,
      y = reorder(variable, MeanDecreaseAccuracy)
    )
  ) +
    geom_segment(
      aes(x = 0, xend = MeanDecreaseAccuracy, y = variable, yend = variable),
      color = "grey70",
      linewidth = 0.8
    ) +
    geom_point(
      size = 3,
      color = "steelblue"
    ) +
    labs(
      x = "Mean Decrease Accuracy",
      y = "",
      title = paste("Random Forest Variable Importance – ", city_name)
    ) +
    theme_minimal(base_size = 26)

  ggsave(
    paste0(
      "C:/Users/u0137615/OneDrive - KU Leuven/Phd GARLOCK/3. Onderzoek/WP3/Paper/Figures/results/rf/RF_importance_NIS_",
      nis, ".png"
    ),
    p,
    width = 15,
    height = 10,
    dpi = 300
  )

  # ---- return tidy table ----
  imp_df %>%
    mutate(NISCODE = nis)
  
  return(p)
}
```

```{r}
gardens_analysis_M <- Manchester_gardens[, c("BAFper_50","BAFtot_50","TWIrisk50","LSTrisk50","vul50","exp50","UGEI_50h")]

gardens_analysis_M  <- st_drop_geometry(gardens_analysis_M)
# Convert all columns to numeric
gardens_analysis_M[] <- lapply(gardens_analysis_M, function(x) as.numeric(as.character(x)))

# Calculate Spearman correlation coefficients
cor_matrix <- cor(gardens_analysis_M, method = "spearman", use="complete.obs")

# Create a correlation heatmap
corrplot(
  cor_matrix,
  method = "color",
  type = "upper",
  tl.cex = 0.8,
  tl.col = "black",
  tl.srt = 45,
  addCoef.col = "black",
  title = "Spearman Correlation Heatmap"
)
```


#linear model
```{r}
gardens_analysis2_M <- Manchester_gardens[, c("TWIrisk50","LSTrisk50","vul50","exp50","UGEI_50h", "BAF1_50","BAF2_50","haz50","IMDhe50", "IMDc50","IMDho50","ONSUNEMP50","ONSHH150", "ONSHH_K50","ONSRent50", "ONSEDU50","ONSEld50","ONSEU50","ONSN_EU50","risk50","bldg_50","garden_50")]

gardens_analysis2 <- st_drop_geometry(gardens_analysis2_M)
# Convert all columns to numeric
gardens_analysis2[] <- lapply(gardens_analysis2, function(x) as.numeric(as.character(x)))

hist(gardens_analysis2$UGEI_50)

# Calculate Spearman correlation coefficients
cor_matrix <- cor(gardens_analysis2, method = "spearman", use="complete.obs")

# Create a correlation heatmap
corrplot(
  cor_matrix,
  method = "color",
  type = "upper",
  tl.cex = 0.8,
  tl.col = "black",
  tl.srt = 45,
  addCoef.col = "black",
  title = "Spearman Correlation Heatmap"
)

model <- lm(UGEI_50h ~ TWIrisk50 + LSTrisk50 + IMDhe50 + IMDc50 + IMDho50 + ONSUNEMP50 + ONSHH150 + ONSHH_K50 + ONSRent50 + ONSEDU50 + ONSEld50 + ONSEU50 + ONSN_EU50, data= gardens_analysis2)
summary(model)

# make a copy to keep your original data safe
gardens_scaled <- gardens_analysis2  

# standardize all predictors except the outcome
predictors <- c("TWIrisk50", "LSTrisk50", "IMDhe50", "IMDc50", "IMDho50", 
                "ONSUNEMP50", "ONSHH150", "ONSHH_K50", "ONSRent50", 
                "ONSEDU50", "ONSEld50", "ONSEU50", "ONSN_EU50","bldg_50","garden_50")

gardens_scaled[predictors] <- scale(gardens_scaled[predictors])

# fit model with standardized predictors
model_scaled <- lm(UGEI_50h ~ ., data = gardens_scaled[, c("UGEI_50h", predictors)])
summary(model_scaled)

library(DHARMa)
# Simulate residuals
sim_res <- simulateResiduals(model_scaled)
# Plot diagnostics
plot(sim_res)

library(glmmTMB)
model_tmb <- glmmTMB(UGEI_rescaled ~ ., data = gardens_scaled[, c("UGEI_50", predictors)],
                     family = beta_family())

library(DHARMa)
sim_res <- simulateResiduals(model_tmb)
plot(sim_res)

library(dotwhisker)
library(broom)
library(ggplot2)

# Tidy model coefficients
coef_df <- tidy(model_scaled, conf.int = TRUE)
coef_df <- subset(coef_df, term != "(Intercept)")

# Add significance column
coef_df$sig <- ifelse(coef_df$p.value < 0.05, "Significant", "Not Significant")

# Add a dummy 'model' column (required by dwplot)
coef_df$model <- "Standardized LM"

# Optional: order predictors
coef_df$term <- factor(coef_df$term, levels = rev(c(
  "TWIrisk50", "LSTrisk50", "BIMDhe50", "BIMDc50", "BIMDho50",
  "STATUNEMP5", "STATHH150", "STATHH_K50", "STATRent50",
  "STATEDU50", "STATEld50", "STATEU50", "STATN_EU50"
)))

# Forest plot using dwplot aesthetics
dwplot(coef_df, dot_args = list(aes(shape = sig, colour = sig), size = 4)) +
  scale_color_manual(values = c("Significant" = "black", "Not Significant" = "grey60")) +
  scale_shape_manual(values = c("Significant" = 16, "Not Significant" = 1)) +  # filled vs hollow
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", color = "red") +
  labs(x = "Standardized Coefficient (β)", y = "",
       title = "Forest Plot of Standardized Model") +
  theme_bw(base_size = 16) +
  theme(legend.position = "none")



```




#HOTSPOT analyse
```{r}
library(spdep)

gardens_analysis3_M <- Manchester_gardens[, c("BAFper_50","BAFtot_50","TWIrisk50","LSTrisk50","vul50","exp50","UGEI_50h", "BAF1_50","BAF2_50","haz50","IMDhe50", "IMDc50","IMDho50","ONSUNEMP50","ONSHH150", "ONSHH_K50","ONSRent50", "ONSEDU50","ONSEld50","ONSEU50","ONSN_EU50","risk50")]

garden_analysis3_subset_M <- gardens_analysis3_M[is.finite(gardens_analysis3_M$UGEI_50h), ]

# Create a neighbor list
list_nb <- poly2nb(garden_analysis3_subset_M, queen=TRUE,  snap=10)

# Check for empty neighbor sets
# card() calculates number of neighbors for each polygon in the list
# which() finds polygons with 0 neighbors
empty_nb <- which(card(list_nb) == 0)
empty_nb  

# Remove polygons with empty neighbor sets from the data
garden_analysis3_subset_M <- garden_analysis3_subset_M[-empty_nb, ]

# Now that we removed empty neighbor sets (tes_subset)
# Identify neighbors with queen contiguity (edge/vertex touching)
tes_nb <- poly2nb(garden_analysis3_subset_M, queen=TRUE,  snap=10)

# Binary weighting assigns a weight of 1 to all neighboring features 
# and a weight of 0 to all other features
tes_w_binary <- nb2listw(tes_nb, style="W")

# Calculate spatial lag of TreEqty
tes_lag <- lag.listw(tes_w_binary, garden_analysis3_subset_M$UGEI_50h)

# Test for global Moran I statistic 
moran.test(garden_analysis3_subset_M$UGEI_50h, tes_w_binary)

local_moran <- localmoran(garden_analysis3_subset_M$UGEI_50h, tes_w_binary)

local_moran <- localmoran(garden_analysis3_subset_M$UGEI_50h, tes_w_binary)

garden_analysis3_subset_M$Ii <- local_moran[, "Ii"]
garden_analysis3_subset_M$Z_Ii <- local_moran[, "Z.Ii"]
garden_analysis3_subset_M$p_value <- local_moran[, "Pr(z != E(Ii))"]

# Spatial lag of UGEI
garden_analysis3_subset_M$UGEI_lag <- lag.listw(tes_w_binary, garden_analysis3_subset_M$UGEI_50h)

# Mean of UGEI
UGEI_mean <- mean(garden_analysis3_subset_M$UGEI_50h, na.rm = TRUE)

# Create cluster category
garden_analysis3_subset_M$cluster <- NA
garden_analysis3_subset_M$cluster[
  garden_analysis3_subset_M$UGEI_50h > UGEI_mean & 
  garden_analysis3_subset_M$UGEI_lag > UGEI_mean & 
  garden_analysis3_subset_M$p_value <= 0.05] <- "High-High"

garden_analysis3_subset_M$cluster[
  garden_analysis3_subset_M$UGEI_50h < UGEI_mean & 
  garden_analysis3_subset_M$UGEI_lag < UGEI_mean & 
  garden_analysis3_subset_M$p_value <= 0.05] <- "Low-Low"

garden_analysis3_subset_M$cluster[
  garden_analysis3_subset_M$UGEI_50h > UGEI_mean & 
  garden_analysis3_subset_M$UGEI_lag < UGEI_mean & 
  garden_analysis3_subset_M$p_value <= 0.05] <- "High-Low"

garden_analysis3_subset_M$cluster[
  garden_analysis3_subset_M$UGEI_50h < UGEI_mean & 
  garden_analysis3_subset_M$UGEI_lag > UGEI_mean & 
  garden_analysis3_subset_M$p_value <= 0.05] <- "Low-High"

# Everything else = not significant
garden_analysis3_subset_M$cluster[is.na(garden_analysis3_subset_M$cluster)] <- "Not significant"

# ---- New: categorize p-values ----
garden_analysis3_subset_M$p_category <- cut(
  garden_analysis3_subset_M$p_value,
  breaks = c(-Inf, 0.001, 0.01, 0.05, Inf),
  labels = c("p <= 0.001", "p <= 0.01", "p <= 0.05", "No significance"),
  right = TRUE
)

# Quick check of counts per cluster and p-value
library(dplyr)

summary_table <- garden_analysis3_subset_M %>%
  group_by(p_category) %>%
  summarise(Number_of_gardens = n(), .groups = "drop") %>%
  mutate(Percent_of_gardens = Number_of_gardens / sum(Number_of_gardens) * 100)

summary_table

cluster_summary <- garden_analysis3_subset_M %>%
  group_by(cluster) %>%
  summarise(Number_of_gardens = n(), .groups = "drop") %>%
  mutate(Percent_of_gardens = Number_of_gardens / sum(Number_of_gardens) * 100)

cluster_summary
```

#BILISA1
```{r}
library(bispdep)
library(dplyr)

gardens_analysis3_M <- Manchester_gardens[, c("BAFper_50","BAFtot_50","TWIrisk50","LSTrisk50","vul50","exp50","UGEI_50h", "BAF1_50","BAF2_50","haz50","IMDhe50", "IMDc50","IMDho50","ONSUNEMP50","ONSHH150", "ONSHH_K50","ONSRent50", "ONSEDU50","ONSEld50","ONSEU50","ONSN_EU50","risk50")]

garden_analysis3_subset_M <- gardens_analysis3_M[is.finite(gardens_analysis3_M$UGEI_50h), ]

# Assume garden_analysis3_subset already cleaned and neighbors defined as tes_w_binary

# Create a neighbor list
list_nb <- poly2nb(garden_analysis3_subset_M, queen=TRUE,  snap=10)

# Check for empty neighbor sets
# card() calculates number of neighbors for each polygon in the list
# which() finds polygons with 0 neighbors
empty_nb <- which(card(list_nb) == 0)
empty_nb  

# Remove polygons with empty neighbor sets from the data
garden_analysis3_subset_M <- garden_analysis3_subset_M[-empty_nb, ]

# Now that we removed empty neighbor sets (tes_subset)
# Identify neighbors with queen contiguity (edge/vertex touching)
tes_nb <- poly2nb(garden_analysis3_subset_M, queen=TRUE,  snap=10)

# Binary weighting assigns a weight of 1 to all neighboring features 
# and a weight of 0 to all other features
tes_w_binary <- nb2listw(tes_nb, style="W")

# Variables
varX <- garden_analysis3_subset_M$haz50   # dependent
varY <- garden_analysis3_subset_M$BAFtot_50  # explanatory

# Run bivariate Local Moran's I
local_bi <- bispdep::localmoran.bi(varX, varY, tes_w_binary, alternative="two.sided")

# Inspect results
head(local_bi)

# Add key columns to your data
garden_analysis3_subset_M$Ii_bi <- local_bi[, "Ixyi"]
garden_analysis3_subset_M$Z_Ii_bi <- local_bi[, "Z.Ixyi"]
garden_analysis3_subset_M$p_value_bi <- local_bi[, "Pr(z != 0)"]

# Spatial lag of varY for cluster assignment
varY_lag <- lag.listw(tes_w_binary, varY)

# Mean values
varX_mean <- mean(varX, na.rm=TRUE)
varY_lag_mean <- mean(varY_lag, na.rm=TRUE)

# Classify bivariate clusters
garden_analysis3_subset_M$cluster_bi <- NA
garden_analysis3_subset_M$cluster_bi[
  varX > varX_mean & varY_lag > varY_lag_mean & garden_analysis3_subset_M$p_value_bi <= 0.05] <- "High-High"
garden_analysis3_subset_M$cluster_bi[
  varX < varX_mean & varY_lag < varY_lag_mean & garden_analysis3_subset_M$p_value_bi <= 0.05] <- "Low-Low"
garden_analysis3_subset_M$cluster_bi[
  varX > varX_mean & varY_lag < varY_lag_mean & garden_analysis3_subset_M$p_value_bi <= 0.05] <- "High-Low"
garden_analysis3_subset_M$cluster_bi[
  varX < varX_mean & varY_lag > varY_lag_mean & garden_analysis3_subset_M$p_value_bi <= 0.05] <- "Low-High"
garden_analysis3_subset_M$cluster_bi[is.na(garden_analysis3_subset_M$cluster_bi)] <- "Not significant"

# Quick summary
# Categorize p-values
garden_analysis3_subset_M$p_category_bi <- cut(
  garden_analysis3_subset_M$p_value_bi,
  breaks = c(-Inf, 0.001, 0.01, 0.05, Inf),
  labels = c("p <= 0.001", "p <= 0.01", "p <= 0.05", "Not significant"),
  right = TRUE
)

# Summarize number and percentage of gardens per cluster
cluster_summary <- garden_analysis3_subset_M %>%
  group_by(cluster_bi) %>%
  summarise(
    Number_of_gardens = n(),
    Percent_of_gardens = n() / nrow(garden_analysis3_subset_M) * 100,
    .groups = "drop"
  )

# Summarize number and percentage of gardens per p-value category
pval_summary <- garden_analysis3_subset_M %>%
  group_by(p_category_bi) %>%
  summarise(
    Number_of_gardens = n(),
    Percent_of_gardens = n() / nrow(garden_analysis3_subset_M) * 100,
    .groups = "drop"
  )

# Print summaries
cluster_summary
pval_summary

global_moran <- moran_bv(varX, varY, tes_w_binary, nsim = 499, scale = TRUE)
global_moran
```

```{r}
run_hotspot_nis <- function(x) {

  x <- x[is.finite(x$UGEI_50h), ]
  if (nrow(x) < 5) return(NULL)

  nb <- poly2nb(x, queen = TRUE, snap = 10)
  iso <- which(card(nb) == 0)
  if (length(iso) > 0) {
    x <- x[-iso, ]
    nb <- poly2nb(x, queen = TRUE, snap = 10)
  }

  lw <- nb2listw(nb, style = "W")
  lm <- localmoran(x$UGEI_50h, lw)

  x$p_value <- lm[, "Pr(z != E(Ii))"]
  x$UGEI_lag <- lag.listw(lw, x$UGEI_50h)
  mu <- mean(x$UGEI_50h, na.rm = TRUE)

  x$cluster <- "Not significant"
  sig <- x$p_value <= 0.05
  x$cluster[sig & x$UGEI_50h > mu & x$UGEI_lag > mu] <- "High-High"
  x$cluster[sig & x$UGEI_50h < mu & x$UGEI_lag < mu] <- "Low-Low"
  x$cluster[sig & x$UGEI_50h > mu & x$UGEI_lag < mu] <- "High-Low"
  x$cluster[sig & x$UGEI_50h < mu & x$UGEI_lag > mu] <- "Low-High"

  x
}

hotspot_results <- map(gardens_by_nis, run_hotspot_nis)
hotspot_results <- hotspot_results[!map_lgl(hotspot_results, is.null)]

run_pca_nis <- function(x, nis) {

  vlabels <- get_var_labels(nis)

  x_pca <- x %>%
    select(all_of(names(vlabels)), cluster) %>%
    st_drop_geometry() %>%
    na.omit()

  if (nrow(x_pca) < 10) return(NULL)

  vars     <- x_pca[, names(vlabels)]
  clusters <- x_pca$cluster

  pca <- prcomp(vars, scale. = TRUE)

  # Rename PCA loadings
  rownames(pca$rotation) <- vlabels[rownames(pca$rotation)]

  city_name <- niscode_names[as.character(nis)]
  if (is.na(city_name)) city_name <- paste("NIS", nis)

  p <- fviz_pca_biplot(
    pca,
    geom.ind = "point",
    col.ind = clusters,
    col.var = "black",
    palette = c(
      "High-High" = "#407ca2",
      "Low-Low"  = "#c85a5a",
      "High-Low" = "#c6d9e4",
      "Low-High" = "#f7d9d9",
      "Not significant" = "grey70"
    ),
    addEllipses = TRUE,
    legend.title = "LISA cluster",
    repel = TRUE
  ) +
    ggtitle(paste("PCA –", city_name))

  ggsave(
    paste0(
      "C:/Users/u0137615/OneDrive - KU Leuven/Phd GARLOCK/3. Onderzoek/WP3/Paper/Figures/results/pca/PCA_",
      city_name, ".png"
    ),
    p,
    width = 10, height = 10, dpi = 300
  )

  return(p)
}

pca_results <- imap(hotspot_results, run_pca_nis)

run_pca_nis <- function(x, nis) {

  vlabels <- get_var_labels(nis)

  x_pca <- x %>%
    select(all_of(names(vlabels))) %>%
    st_drop_geometry() %>%
    na.omit()

  if (nrow(x_pca) < 10) return(NULL)

  pca <- prcomp(x_pca, scale. = TRUE)

  loadings <- as.data.frame(pca$rotation[, 1:2]) %>%
    tibble::rownames_to_column("variable") %>%
    mutate(
      variable = vlabels[variable],
      city = niscode_names[as.character(nis)]
    )

  loadings
}

run_rf_nis <- function(x, nis) {

  x <- x %>% filter(cluster %in% c("High-High", "Low-Low"))
  if (nrow(x) < 20) return(NULL)

  # ---- predictors for this city ----
  vlabels <- get_var_labels(nis)
  predictors <- names(vlabels)

  # keep only needed columns
  x_rf <- x %>%
    select(cluster, all_of(predictors)) %>%
    st_drop_geometry() %>%
    na.omit()

  if (nrow(x_rf) < 20) return(NULL)

  # ---- dynamic RF formula ----
  rf_formula <- as.formula(
    paste("as.factor(cluster) ~", paste(predictors, collapse = " + "))
  )

  rf <- randomForest(
    rf_formula,
    data = x_rf,
    importance = TRUE,
    ntree = 500
  )

  # ---- importance table ----
  rf_labels_use <- get_rf_labels(nis)

  imp_df <- importance(rf) %>%
    as.data.frame() %>%
    tibble::rownames_to_column("variable") %>%
    select(variable, MeanDecreaseAccuracy) %>%
    mutate(variable = rf_labels_use[variable]) %>%
    arrange(MeanDecreaseAccuracy)

  city_name <- niscode_names[as.character(nis)]
  if (is.na(city_name)) city_name <- paste("NIS", nis)

  # ---- lollipop plot ----
  p <- ggplot(
    imp_df,
    aes(x = MeanDecreaseAccuracy,
        y = reorder(variable, MeanDecreaseAccuracy))
  ) +
    geom_segment(
      aes(x = 0, xend = MeanDecreaseAccuracy,
          y = variable, yend = variable),
      color = "grey70",
      linewidth = 0.8
    ) +
    geom_point(size = 3, color = "steelblue") +
    labs(
      x = "Mean Decrease Gini",
      y = "",
      title = paste("Random Forest Variable Importance –", city_name)
    ) +
    theme_minimal(base_size = 26)

  ggsave(
    paste0(
      "C:/Users/u0137615/OneDrive - KU Leuven/Phd GARLOCK/3. Onderzoek/WP3/Paper/Figures/results/rf/RF_importance_",
      city_name, ".png"
    ),
    p,
    width = 15, height = 10, dpi = 300
  )

  imp_df %>% mutate(NISCODE = nis)
}
```
